items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: I met him at the Institute, Bennett Lester Carter. Benny Carter.

ctx.x: Who are the most, I don’t know, short list of the most interesting people you’ve met doing your work?

Well I didn’t meet him, but I did some work for him, long distance work for him. I did some work on Leonard Feather’s book, Earwitness to an Era.” I think it was his last book. And he couldn’t come out to the Institute so he sort of hired me to do some digging and stuff. And he paid me nicely, gave me check and everything. And I knew of him, I © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-

knew about him from reading and all of that and I knew all of the great things he did in terms of promoting the music and everything. And so I was very happy and proud to work for Leonard Feather. As far as meeting other people, Gunther Schuller, I met Gunther Schuller who I thought was one of the nicest people ever. He was doing some work on his book about the Swing Era. He pulled out about a ton of LPs and sat down and listened to these things over and over and over again, which was great. And I really enjoyed…

items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: I met him at the Institute, Bennett Lester Carter. Benny Carter. ... So when Benny came to the Institute, I even remember the first stupid question I asked him... I said, 'Mr. Carter, could you sit down and tell me...'

ctx.x: I bet today there would be a designated psychological definition for what he was about. © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

Yeah. I’ll tell you who has probably very good insight, and you should talk to him if you haven’t already, is Loren Schoenberg at the Jazz Museum in Harlem. Because he worked with Benny for a number of years. And he got the full treatment, everything from praise to damnation, he got the whole thing. And Benny took his band away from him eventually. He took off his gloves man.
Touché. You know Joe Wilder, he went on that tour to Russia.
